ex.s: A noise at a window caught my attention, so I entered it.
ex.t: 窗户旁的响动引起了我的注意，于是我走了进去。

ex.s: On the other side of my bed curtain, I heard a patient cheerfully  18  every nurse as they entered the room, as if welcoming each into his home.
ex.t: 在我的床帘另一边，我听到一位病人愉快地18 每一位进来的护士，仿佛欢迎她们来到他的家中。

ex.s: I didn’t realize how right my parents are until I entered high school.
ex.t: 300多年来，其人口从800人逐渐增长到800万人。

ex.s: The possibility of entering into and losing such a match should concentrate the minds of computer scientists.
ex.t: 陷入并输掉这样一局棋的可能性，理应让计算机科学家集中注意力。

defs.def: to become a member of an institution; to start working in an organization or a profession 成为 … 的一员；加入；开始从事

ex.s: About one month after this photo was took, I entered my second year of high school and become a new member of the school music club.
ex.t: 大约在这张照片拍完一个月后，我进入高中二年级，成为学校音乐俱乐部的新成员。

ex.s: Yet， now that I'm growing and the world I once knew as being so simple is becoming more complex， I find myself needing a way to escape． By opening a novel， I can leave behind my burdens and enter into a wonderful and mysterious world where I am now a new character． In these worlds I can become anyone． I don't have to write down what happened or what technique the author was using when he or she wrote this． I just read to relax．
ex.t: 然而，随着我渐渐长大，曾经以为如此简单的世界变得越来越复杂，我发现自己需要一种逃避的方式。打开一本小说，我就能抛开烦恼，进入一个奇妙而神秘的世界，在那里我成为一个新的角色。在这些世界里我可以成为任何人。我不必记下发生了什么，也不必分析作者写作时运用了什么技巧。我阅读只是为了放松。

ex.s: The museum was free． We entered， excited． A group of people sitting in the hall stopped talking and stared at us．
ex.t: 博物馆免费。我们兴奋地走进去。大厅里坐着的一群人停下交谈，盯着我们看。

defs.def: to begin or become involved in an activity, a situation, etc. 开始参加；开始进入；着手进行

ex.s: C her strong urge to follow the crowdD. her dream of entering a top university
ex.t: C 她随大流的强烈冲动D. 她进入顶尖大学的梦想

ex.s: SoFi Stadium requires you to park strictly in your assigned zone, and guests must enter through the exact gate indicated on their color-coded digital parking pass.
ex.t: SoFi体育场要求你严格在指定区域停车，并且宾客必须通过其彩色编码电子停车证上标明的确切入口进入。

ex.s: If you enter through the wrong access point, you'll be turned around and redirected — so plan ahead.
ex.t: 如果你从错误的入口进入，会被拦下并重新指引——所以请提前规划。

ex.s: Upon entering the correct zone, parking staff will guide you directly to a space.
ex.t: 一旦进入正确的区域，停车管理员会直接引导你到车位。

ex.s: We need to exit the things that don’t work anymore to be able to enter the ones that make sense for who we are today.
ex.t: 我们需要放弃那些不再有效的事情，才能进入那些对我们今天来说有意义的事物。

ex.s: What did the author realize after entering school in Brooklyn?
ex.t: 作者进入布鲁克林的学校后意识到了什么？

ex.s: And MP3 players, smart phones, and LCD TVs entered homes in 2002, before tablets and e-readers showed up in 2007.
ex.t: MP3播放器、智能手机和液晶电视在2002年进入家庭，之后平板电脑和电子阅读器在2007年出现。

ex.s: The historian Francis Cole argues that the West has entered a period where “only the present exists, a present characterised at once by the cruelty of the instant and by the boredom of an unending now”.
ex.t: 历史学家弗朗西斯·科尔认为，西方已进入一个"只有当下存在"的时期，这个当下同时以瞬间的残酷和无尽现在的无聊为特征。

ex.s: It reminds her that children don’t enter life  47  to take risks or unwilling to  48  again when they fall down.
ex.t: 这提醒她，孩子进入生活时并不____47____去冒险，也不是在跌倒后不愿再次____48____。

ex.s: You’ve heard that plastic is polluting the oceans—between 4.8 and 12.7 million tonnes enter ocean ecosystems every year.
ex.t: 你听说过塑料正在污染海洋——每年有480万到1270万吨进入海洋生态系统。

defs.def: to put your name on the list for an exam, a race, a competition, etc; to do this for sb 报名参加，为 … 报名参加（考试、比赛等）

ex.s: Individuals or groups may enter one of the following categories：
ex.t: 个人或团体可以参加以下类别之一：

ex.s: Thirty years later， a woman approached me in a public place． "Excuse me， did you ever enter a residence， long ago， thinking it was the McNay Museum？"
ex.t: 三十年后，一位女士在公共场所走近我。“打扰一下，你很久以前是否曾进过一户住宅，以为那是麦克奈博物馆？”

ex.s: When I was in middle school, my social studies teacher asked me to enter a writing contest I said no without thinking.
ex.t: 上中学时，我的社会课老师让我参加一个写作比赛，我想都没想就拒绝了。

ex.s: When I was in middle school, my social studies teacher asked me to enter a writing contest I said no without thinking.
ex.t: 上中学时，我的社会课老师让我参加一个写作比赛，我想都没想就拒绝了。

ex.s: Who would most probably enter for Take a view?
ex.t: 谁最可能报名参加Take a view？

ex.s: Expert gardeners know just the right corner for roses, and others spend hours trying to grow perfect vegetables to enter into competitions.
ex.t: 专业园丁最清楚玫瑰适合种在哪个角落，而其他人则花上好几个小时试图种出完美的蔬菜去参加比赛。

ex.s: They can enter the competition.
ex.t: 他们可以参加比赛。

ex.s: This year I entered the Great Gorilla Run in London.
ex.t: 今年我参加了伦敦的大猩猩跑活动。

ex.s: Then, the teacher wanted to enter her homework into a writing competition.
ex.t: 然后，老师想把她的作业提交到一个写作比赛中。

defs.def: to put names, numbers, details, etc. in a list, book or computer 登记，录入，输入（姓名、号码、详细资料等）

ex.s: •Based on the information entered by each student, potential pairs are identified.
ex.t: •根据每位学生输入的信息，确定潜在的双人配对。

defs.def: to say sth officially so that it can be recorded （正式）提出

ex.s: New-born chicks can then imitate their mom’s call within a few days of entering the world.
ex.t: 新生的小鸡在来到这个世界几天内就能模仿母亲的声音。

ex.s: I entered the room and the teachers made me say some lines from the musical.
ex.t: 我走进房间，老师们让我念了音乐剧里的几句台词。

defs.def: to begin to discuss or deal with sth 开始讨论；着手处理

ex.s: After you have revised your draft until it is too messy to work from anymore, you can enter your changes into your word processor.
ex.t: 在您修改了您的草稿之后，直到它变得太乱了，从现在开始，您可以输入您的更改到您的文字处理器中 。

defs.def: to take an active part in sth 积极参加；投入
to form part of sth or have an influence on sth 成为 … 的一部分；影响

ex.s: (Son enters room.) Father: Not again!
ex.t: （儿子进了房间。）父亲：别又来了！
